gina: quick thread 07 opened PR to unify tool-calling examples + parsing shim. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9123

omar (eng): skimmed. we should show a strict jsonschema and a compatibility shim for older clients. keep examples minimal.

leah (sdk): agreed. SDK will map snake_case -> camelCase and surface parsingConfidence. will add small unit test.

felix (support): customers hit mismatched `args` shapes. can we add a short migration note that suggests `args: {}` fallback?

gina: added note: "If `args` missing, SDK shims to empty object; set parsingConfidence=0."

omar (eng): small perf note: recommend `kv_cache:true` for v2 where applicable and show routing fallback sample.

leah (sdk): I'll push an example snippet: `const parsed = parseResponse(resp) || { action: 'noop', args: {}, parsingConfidence: 0 }`

gina: sanitized examples (no PII). deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/9123/index.html

deploy-bot: preview updated

felix (support): drafting a support blurb to link to the preview.

gina: thanks all 1f389 merged after CI green. closing.
